cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: A Kinder Version
cards.instruction: Protect someone from the full truth by offering a carefully edited explanation that feels kinder than complete honesty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The gallery thinks your portrait would suit a more adventurous exhibition.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're showing a fridge full of teeth. What did they say about mine?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. That the face doesn't immediately reveal what you intended.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's you. They called it unrecognisable, didn't they?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They think knowing the sitter would help. I'll attend your next opening with a matching shirt.
